description: Call right before you pay for a purchase check_purchase allowed. If the workspace's owner changed the spend policy since the purchase was approved (a lower maximum, a lower daily cap, a blocked seller), it is checked again under the rules as they stand now. confirmed true: pay now. An error saying the policy changed: do not pay; the hold was released, so check the purchase again. Only while the workspace has confirming switched on (the reservation then names confirm). Needs a Last Price credential with price compute scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.
name: confirm_purchase
